points.description: States that Bulb A is still in a closed path (circuit/loop) with the battery, i.e. it remains connected in a complete loop to the battery so it is not disconnected from the supply.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that Bulb A remains in a closed circuit path with the battery. Equivalent wording such as "still part of a complete loop with the cell" earns the mark. No partial credit, as the answer is a single idea.
